gloss: parenthetical note; text in brackets; annotation in parentheses

definitions.gloss: parenthetical note; text in brackets; annotation in parentheses
definitions.explanation: Text that is written inside parentheses or brackets, typically serving as supplementary information, clarification, or a secondary reading.

examples.japanese: {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: I added a supplementary note in parentheses.

examples.japanese: {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: You may omit the part in parentheses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条文|じょうぶん}→条文：16622_joubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦づらい→〜づらい：18368_zurai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Legal texts contain many parenthetical annotations, and not a few people find them hard to read.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ (parentheses; brackets) + {書|が}き (writing). Refers to the act of writing in parentheses or the resulting parenthetical text itself. Very common in formal writing, legal documents, and academic texts where supplementary information or readings need to be provided.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to indicate in parentheses
- {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: the parenthetical portion
- {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to omit the parenthetical
- {括弧|かっこ}{書|が}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show the reading in parentheses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation; explanatory note — broader term for any kind of explanatory addition
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧: supplement; addition — the content being added, not specifically in brackets
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — an annotation placed at the bottom of a page
